dedupe_keys.name: pjm long term load forecast and data centre accuracy report

description: This PJM page holds the documents and data behind the grid operator's load forecast, including a Data Center Accuracy Report dated 29 May 2026. Contents: the 2026 Long-Term Load Forecast report, tables and data workbook, a mid-year update, weather-normalised zonal peaks, sector models and end-use indices, forecast assumptions (households, population, output, income, employment), electric vehicle totals, behind-the-meter solar and battery forecasts, load adjustments, model coefficients and residuals, hourly forecasts by zone and forecast adjustment documentation for utilities such as AEP, Dominion and Exelon. Producer: PJM Interconnection, the regional transmission organisation whose planning department maintains Manual 19 on load forecasting. Coverage: the PJM footprint in the United States, by zone. Access: PDF, Excel and ZIP downloads on the page with no login seen. Licence and cost: free to download; no reuse licence is stated. Caveats: the forecast covers all load, so data centre demand must be isolated through the accuracy report and load adjustment files, and zonal detail is limited to what PJM publishes. Simulation uses: an open baseline of projected demand, including large data centre loads, for capacity planning and grid-adequacy studies. It complements PJM's market and operations feeds described in data-pjm-data-miner-2.
